title: Paul Tagliabue, NFL commissioner for 17 years, dies at 84
summary: Paul Tagliabue, who helped bring labor peace and riches to the NFL during his 17 years as commissioner but was criticized for not taking stronger action on concussions, died on Sunday at 84 years old.

title: US highlights Gaza aid surge; Palestinians allege ‘engineered starvation’
summary: White House says nearly 700 aid trucks entering Gaza each day, a figure disputed by Palestinians and aid organisations.
